description: This file defines the class SugarSpot, which provides global search functionality within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for performing searches across modules, formatting search results, and generating search queries, as well as handling configuration and ACL checks.

classes.name: SugarSpot
classes.description: A class providing search functionalities across modules in SuiteCRM, including executing searches, formatting results, and managing search modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the current module context.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and renders the results as an HTML widget.

methods.name: formatSearchResultsToDisplay
methods.description: Formats raw search result data into displayable results.

methods.name: getSearchFields
methods.description: Loads SearchFields configuration for a given module, considering customizations.

methods.name: _getCount
methods.description: Executes a count query for a given seed and main query.

methods.name: getSearchModules
methods.description: Determines which modules should be included in the search based on user preferences and configuration.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search across selected modules with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: _performSearch
methods.description: Executes the actual search logic, composing queries for each module.

methods.name: _searchKeys
methods.description: Walks through arrays to find keys matching search patterns, prioritizing modules and values.

methods.name: filterSearchType
methods.description: Filters search fields based on their data type and the query string, to ensure appropriate searches.
